summary: Accepted for pull-request review on source-only evidence. All ten criterion floors are met and the frozen weighted score is 4.64, with no source-level blocking finding. The candidate is especially strong on role legibility, emerging-work framing, bounded evidence, collective credit, operational credibility, cross-practice continuity, and explicit human decision governance. Visual proof remains the weakest criterion because CallNYC is the only case with a cleared inspectable image and most other artifact treatments are descriptive. This verdict does not claim any command, browser, staging, deployment, human corroboration, rights-clearance, exact-SHA approval, or production gate complete; all five required human/external gates remain open.
